addCompetingToken(address,address,addres.details: This function can only be called by the ILiquidityMigrator.

params.locker: The locker created for the liquidity position.
params.otherToken: The address of the other token in the Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity pool for the token.
params.pool: The address of the Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity pool for the token.
params.token: The address of the token to add (must be a non-zero address).
The address of the token to collect fees from its Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity pool and burn

emitNewLockManagerAndNFT(address,address.details: This function can only be called by a burnable token, that has migrated and is part of the competing tokens.

params.lockNFT: The address of the lock NFT contract.

params.token: The isntance of the token address.

addCompetingToken(address,address,addres.notice: Adds a competing token to the FeeAccount contract.

collectFeesAndDistribute(address).notice: Collects fees generated in the token's pool, distributes them among holders and dev, and rewards the caller. The reward in WETH is calculated as collectedWethAmount * collectRewardPercent / FEE_SCALE (scale of thousand).dev reward is not immediately transferred, but locked for a period of time (devRewardsCliff) in a lock position NFT. The lock NFT is transferred to the dev, so they can unclock the reward, once the lock expires. If the dev address is a contract, it must implement the IERC721Receiver interface to receive the lock NFT. Otherwise the reward will be distributed to the lock position NFT holders.
